# A per-acre rate that starts from your machine, not a rumor.

> Free calculator for custom farm operators: find the rate to charge per acre for combining, planting, spraying, baling, or tillage work, from your own machine speed, width, fuel, repairs, ownership cost, and labor — then check a season of jobs against an income goal.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
